load_image_with_cv2: create a function that loads an image or depthmap from a file path using OpenCV and converts BGR to RGB
convert_tensor_to_rgb: create a function that converts a PyTorch tensor or numpy array to a normalized RGB image
resize_pil_image: create a function that resizes a PIL image to a target long edge size using LANCZOS or BICUBIC interpolation
load_images_for_dust3r: create a function that loads and normalizes all images from a folder or list into DUSt3R input format
